name: Supreme Facility Management Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2005, Supreme Facility Service Management Limited offers integrated facility management services, such as housekeeping and cleaning, disinfecting and sanitizing, staffing, and corporate food solution services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Model[1]
The company is as an integrated business services provider focusing on Integrated Facility Management (IFM) services and Support Services across industries. Its model emphasizes annuity-based B2B services that leverage people, processes, and technology to deliver solutions efficiently.
Service Portfolio[2]
1. Integrated Facility Management (IFM):
   - Soft Services: Housekeeping, pest control, sanitization, horticulture, facade cleaning.
   - Hard Services: Maintenance of HVAC systems, plumbing, electrical, and other technical services.
   - Staffing Services: Manpower supply for support operations.

Support Services:[3]
Employee Transportation (ET): Shuttle, private car, and bus services.
Corporate Food Solutions (CFS): Catering and cafeteria management.
Production Support Services (PSS): Outsourcing production tasks like assembly, packaging, and quality control.
Supply Chain Management (SCM): Warehousing, logistics, and value-added services like packaging and labeling.

Revenue Bifurcation FY24[4]
IFM Services: 65.04%
Employee Transportation Services: 21.61%
Production Support Services: 4.07%
Corporate Food Solution Services: 3.23%
Supply Chain Management Services: 6.04%
Geographical Presence[5]
Co. primarily operates in Maharashtra, contributing 81.39% of its FY24 revenue, with additional operations across Western, Northern, Southern, and Central India. Other key revenue sources include Gujarat (9.44%), Karnataka (5.34%), and smaller contributions from states like Uttar Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.88 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
